scope: Static source/metadata plus analytical arrays and mocked execution controls. No saved patient or source-surface arrays, VTK API, native mesher, solver or model execution.
prospective_input_checks: Declared four packet hashes and directional sample counts match prior saved-audit metadata; original array bytes were not reopened.
independent_controls: Original lattice identity and global witness ordinals across a 256-face chunk boundary, with interleaved triangle sizes and deterministic ties; analytic distance to the z=0 plane.
Whole-face area weighting and quantile thresholds distinguish a 20%-area component from its 50%-face-count fraction; edge-connected component attribution verified.
Closed tall octagonal bipyramid separates the fixed 30-degree and 60-degree adjacent-normal proxy categories.
Post-publication output-cap failure cannot leave durable completed acceptance.
False SetBackend or non-Sequential GetBackend rejects the worker before any saved-array load or helper import.
source_checks: Six-file exact committed archive closure and full 40-hex commit; fixed source/attempt paths, fresh directory, explicit root release.
Original numerical helper hash is pinned; declared saved-input hashes, package versions and post-run hashes constrain the diagnostic.
120-second parent /110-second cooperative /2-GiB sampled RSS /one numerical thread /8-MiB sampled output /1.2-million distance-query caps; all witness/probe calls charged and no retries.
Original sample order and group-cover arithmetic retained; real replay must match saved counts and extrema within the declared tolerance.
Per-triangle fields are face maxima, discrete normal proxies and edge-connected witness labels; whole-face area is not an exact excursion-area integral.
No Gmsh generation, MRI/mask/landmark reader, solver, optimizer or mesh-acceptance path.

findings_resolved_before_independent_exe.finding: Final acceptance publication needed a post-publication cap failure status update.
findings_resolved_before_independent_exe.resolution: Owner writes failed status and error on cap breach; independent mocked control passed.

findings_resolved_before_independent_exe.finding: VTK Sequential request previously ignored the return and actual backend.
findings_resolved_before_independent_exe.resolution: Owner requires both SetBackend success and GetBackend Sequential; both rejection controls passed.

limits: No real saved-geometry diagnostic result or native-library validation is claimed by these controls.
Sampled RSS/output controls are not exact peaks or atomic aggregate quotas; long operations are bounded by the parent supervisor.
Normal-change associations do not establish curvature, anatomy, Gmsh seam location or error causality; seam IDs were not retained.
Whole faces containing sampled witnesses are counted by area; threshold-exceeding area inside each face is not integrated.
Original failed meshes remain rejected regardless of diagnostic completion. No new mesh, size selection, anatomy acceptance or solver release follows.
